description: This file defines the ResultSet class for 'Project' entities within the Coocook schema, including methods for sorting, filtering, and querying project records based on various criteria such as URL name, archive status, visibility, and recency.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Project
classes.description: ResultSet class for handling collections of 'Project' records, providing methods for sorting, filtering, and identifying stale or public projects.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the columns used for sorting projects, specifically 'url_name_fc' and 'name'.

methods.name: find_by_url_name
methods.description: Finds a project record by its URL name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: not_archived
methods.description: Filters projects that are not archived.

methods.name: public
methods.description: Filters projects that are marked as public.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are completely in the past based on a pivot date, indicating they can be archived.
